name: sweep_ground
text: A person standing upright sweeps a small patch beside their right foot with a long broom. The upper left hand steadies the handle close to the chest, and the lower right hand holds it beside the right hip. The right elbow hangs down close to the waist. Gentle short sideways sweeping stroke and smooth return, with a relaxed subtle shift of weight. Keep the handle close to the body and the feet planted.

review.notes_zh: Hsinlung 否决上一版源动作和映射效果：下方右臂过于前伸。本次重做握持姿势，右肘垂在腰侧，右手靠近右胯，扫帚在右脚旁短幅扫动。源动作重新生成；未更改通用映射、比例或添加手部覆盖。待 Hsinlung 看画面验收。
review.rejected: Free pilot/first loop leaned too far and had poor return strokes. Position-only effector offsets were undone by rotation-based correction. Sparse contact keyframes jerked; the final input stores consistent joint positions and rotations for both hands at each contact sample. One identical sparse attempt was rerun accidentally. Hsinlung rejected the previous integrated clip: excessive hand amplitude (source root-relative lateral span 0.303 m upper hand, 0.452 m lower hand). Same seed retained; changed the contact geometry and motion description instead of seed hunting. Hsinlung also rejected the reduced-amplitude version: lower right arm too far forward. The fresh unconstrained pilot leaned excessively and reversed the intended grip order, so its sweeping segment was not used.

pilot.text: A person naturally sweeps the floor with a long handled broom, making two slow small sweeping strokes. They hold the broom close to their right side. The left hand holds the top near the lower chest, the right hand holds lower down near the right hip. The right elbow hangs loosely beside the waist and stays close to the ribs, the forearm angled gently inward. Slight forward lean and subtle weight transfer as the bristles brush the floor diagonally beside the feet, then a relaxed return. Small relaxed arm movement, feet remain in place.

constraint_input.description: New semantic grip poses based on frame 0 of the fresh pilot. Arm IK sets the right elbow beside the waist and the lower grip beside the right hip; the upper left grip crosses toward the same handle. Full-body keys 0,30,60, with consistent local grip constraints every five frames. Final motion and intermediate body movement are generated by Kimodo.

review.visual_review: Reviewed 30 samples over the cycle in original/mapped front and side comparisons; reviewed 30 runtime samples each at front, side and three-quarter views. Exported two-cycle GIF combining original source side view and runtime side/three-quarter views. User acceptance remains pending.
known_limitations: Stationary two-second short sweeping loop; no progression across the floor.
